entities.summary: Aleksandr Sergeyevich Zatsepin is a Russian composer, known for his soundtracks to movies, notably comedies directed by Leonid Gaidai. He received the titles of People's Artist of Russia (2003) and Hero of Labour of the Russian Federation (2025).
